models_evaluated: commercially available AI algorithm for pulmonary embolism detection (unnamed)

links.outcome: AI versus prospective radiologist detection of incidental pulmonary emboli on the same CT exams
links.effect: Radiologists detected 218 IPE prospectively; AI found an additional 36, missed 30 radiologist-detected cases, and had 94 false positives. AI had similar sensitivity but reduced PPV.
links.quote: Compared with radiologists, AI had similar sensitivity but reduced positive predictive value.

links.outcome: Emboli missed by AI that radiologists detected, supporting need for human review
links.effect: AI missed 30 IPE detected by radiologists (one large central embolus, 23 solitary subsegmental) and had 94 false positives; human plus AI was better than either alone.
links.quote: AI missed 30 cases of IPE detected by the radiologists and had 94 false positives.

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of a commercial AI tool compared to radiologists for detecting incidental pulmonary emboli on CT, concluding human oversight is needed, but does not test an organizational deployment practice.
